A devastating fire broke out on August 6 in a densely populated residential neighborhood in Tondo, Manila, Philippines. The blaze rapidly spread through several homes, prompting emergency services to rush to the scene. Authorities are still assessing the damage and investigating the cause of the fire. Local residents were seen evacuating with their belongings as thick smoke engulfed the area.
